description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, causes [Imperil Dark 20% (25s)], grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dark Resonance +5% Boost], and [Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Nabaat v2)] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Nabaat v2)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Blood Gear after every Dark ability
